revealPolicy.rule: All sanitized daily display rows are embedded in the public site. Receipts, logs, source workbooks and model internals stay local.

wnba.Headline: Chicago hosts Seattle following Hiedeman's 31-point game
wnba.Description: Seattle Storm (6-19, 1-12 Western Conference) at Chicago Sky (7-16, 1-7 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Golden State takes on Indiana, seeks 5th straight road win
wnba.Description: Golden State Valkyries (17-7, 7-5 Western Conference) at Indiana Fever (14-9, 5-4 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Los Angeles visits Minnesota following McBride's 37-point game
wnba.Description: Los Angeles Sparks (10-12, 5-6 Western Conference) at Minnesota Lynx (18-6, 11-1 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Lynx rookie Miles reaches 400 points, 100 rebounds, 100 assists
wnba.Description: Minnesota rookie Olivia Miles scored a career-high 33, becoming the first WNBA player to reach 400 points, 100 rebounds and 100 assists in only 22 career games, and the Lynx defeated the Phoenix Mercury 104-100 Monday night for a third straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Kayla McBride, Olivia Miles star in the Lynx's 104-100 win over the Mercury
wnba.Description: — Kayla McBride scored a season-high 37 points, rookie Olivia Miles had a career-high 33 and the Minnesota Lynx beat the Phoenix Mercury 104-100 on Monday night for their third straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota Lynx vs. Phoenix Mercury - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Minnesota Lynx vs. Phoenix Mercury, 07/13/2026

wnba.Headline: Dream beat the Sparks 101-92 behind Angel Reese's WNBA-leading 16th double-double
wnba.Description: — Angel Reese had 23 points and 13 rebounds for her WNBA-leading 16th double-double of the season, Allisha Gray added 20 points, and the Atlanta Dream beat the Los Angeles Sparks 101-92 on Monday night.

wnba.Headline: Atlanta Dream vs. Los Angeles Sparks - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Atlanta Dream vs. Los Angeles Sparks, 07/13/2026

wnba.Headline: 2026 WNBA championship odds: Valkyries now fourth-shortest on futures market
wnba.Description: Entering the week at 17-7, the Golden State Valkyries now have the fourth-shortest odds to win the WNBA title.

wnba.Headline: Fantasy women's hoops: Gustafson, Lacan and more players to add this week
wnba.Description: With one full week left before the All-Star break, here are four players to help you win your weekly matchup.

wnba.Headline: Connecticut faces Portland on 3-game home skid
wnba.Description: Portland Fire (10-13, 3-6 Western Conference) at Connecticut Sun (5-18, 2-8 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Washington visits Toronto after Mabrey's 30-point game
wnba.Description: Washington Mystics (11-10, 7-5 Eastern Conference) at Toronto Tempo (10-13, 5-6 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Fever beat Aces again as Caitlin Clark scores 12 in 24 minutes
wnba.Description: The Fever beat the defending champion Aces in Las Vegas for the second time in eight days. Caitlin Clark, who has been dealing with back issues, played 24 minutes and finished with 12 points, seven rebounds and six assists.

wnba.Headline: Kelsey Mitchell, Caitlin Clark lead Fever to 109-75 win over A'ja Wilson and the Aces
wnba.Description: — Caitlin Clark had 12 points, seven rebounds and six assists, Kelsey Mitchell scored 27 points, and the Indiana Fever beat A'ja Wilson and the Las Vegas Aces 109-75 on Sunday night.

wnba.Headline: Las Vegas Aces vs. Indiana Fever - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Las Vegas Aces vs. Indiana Fever, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Bueckers' 22 points, 11 rebounds help Wings beat Sky 96-91, extend win streak to 5 games
wnba.Description: — Paige Bueckers had 22 points and 11 assists, Jessica Shepard added 19 points and 10 rebounds, and the Dallas Wings beat the Chicago Sky 96-91 on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Dallas Wings vs. Chicago Sky - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Dallas Wings vs. Chicago Sky, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Betnijah Laney-Hamilton ejected after tossing shoe that hit Marina Mabrey
wnba.Description: The Tempo outlasted the Liberty 93-91 Sunday in Montreal after an eventful fourth quarter that saw New York's Betnijah Laney-Hamilton ejected for tossing a shoe that hit Toronto's Marina Mabrey in the back.

wnba.Headline: Toronto Tempo vs. New York Liberty - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Toronto Tempo vs. New York Liberty, 07/12/2026

wnba.Headline: Mabrey scores 30, Tempo blow 20-point lead but beat Liberty 93-91 in Montreal
wnba.Description: — Marina Mabrey scored 30 points, Nyara Sabally made the tiebreaking basket with 52 seconds left after Toronto blew a 20-point lead, and the Tempo beat the New York Liberty 93-91 on Sunday at the Bell Centre.
